name: fire form
desc:
The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
In addition, the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
